items.statement: Chemically defined source components and derived models
items.expected: Preserve source reagent identities and explicitly define any adduct/chain-end graph, charge/spin and composition. Constructed oligomers must be labeled models. Reference comparisons must conserve inventories or account for reservoirs and coproducts. Score only the part supported by valid artifacts: full credit for a sufficient valid argument within scope; partial credit for a correct but incomplete evidential chain; no credit for assertions, wrong objects/references or missing decisive evidence. Do not penalize absence of a particular author/V1 operation when an adequate alternative exists.

Generate results that address how PA addition changes relevant molecular interactions. Distances, populations, binding thermodynamics and reactivity metrics support different claims; their interpretation must match their definition. No mandatory PA/no-PA chain or named pathway matrix. Score only the part supported by valid artifacts: full credit for a sufficient valid argument within scope; partial credit for a correct but incomplete evidential chain; no credit for assertions, wrong objects/references or missing decisive evidence. Do not penalize absence of a particular author/V1 operation when an adequate alternative exists.

items.statement: Connection from interaction to chemical role
items.expected: Assess whether evidence establishes activation, association or a kinetic effect. A contact or more positiveP charge alone does not prove faster propagation or suppressed backbiting. If a reaction barrier is claimed, establish the corresponding physical path; alternative bounded interaction arguments remain eligible. Score only the part supported by valid artifacts: full credit for a sufficient valid argument within scope; partial credit for a correct but incomplete evidential chain; no credit for assertions, wrong objects/references or missing decisive evidence. Do not penalize absence of a particular author/V1 operation when an adequate alternative exists.

Address model uncertainties capable of changing the conclusion with actual evidence. Association comparisons must use consistent standard states and concentration/solvent assumptions. No forced10-fold dilution or fixedEt3B count per molecular cluster. Score only the part supported by valid artifacts: full credit for a sufficient valid argument within scope; partial credit for a correct but incomplete evidential chain; no credit for assertions, wrong objects/references or missing decisive evidence. Relate local findings to source probe observations with explicit representativeness limits. Support, correction and well-investigated unresolved conclusions are eligible. No direct prediction of bulk molecular weight, productivity or antidilution performance from a short isolated model. Score only the part supported by valid artifacts: full credit for a sufficient valid argument within scope; partial credit for a correct but incomplete evidential chain; no credit for assertions, wrong objects/references or missing decisive evidence.
